ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_NEW_EXPIRY_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure calc_new_expiry_date (p_product_type in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_group in VARCHAR2,
 p_attr_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_proc_date in date,
 p_new_expdate out date)
is
 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 select decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_proc_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(p_proc_date,
 life_span * 12),
 'H',p_proc_date+(life_span / 24)),
 temp_life_span_ind
 into p_new_expdate,temp_life_span_ind
 from valid_product_attributes
 where product_type = p_product_type
 and attrib_group = p_attr_group
 and attrib_code = p_attr_code
 and life_span is not null
 and life_span_ind is not null
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 if temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 then
 p_new_expdate :=
 to_date(to_char(p_new_expdate,'mmddyyyy')||'235959',
 'mmddyyyyhh24miss') ;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 p_new_expdate := :expiry_date;
end;
